## Purpose and research design

This notebook contains the complete relative-value strategy analysis used in
the thesis. It starts from the raw weekly futures and T-bill files, rebuilds
the annual expanding-window Schwartz--Smith (2000) signal, develops two simple
benchmarks, carries out the pre-specified calibration search, freezes one
strategy using 2000--2016 only, and then evaluates 2017--2025 once.

Intermediate checks are included where they protect against look-ahead, state-boundary, 
execution, cost, or accounting errors.

### Research sequence

1. Estimate the SS2000 model with an expanding training sample, beginning with
   1990--1999 and re-estimating at each calendar-year boundary.
2. Build a one-contract signal-only benchmark and a risk-managed version of
   the same unfiltered directional signal.
3. Compare the pre-specified timing candidates over 2000--2016 with one
   contract, so timing and sizing are not mixed.
4. Check the leading timing region locally and apply the
   fixed-at-entry sizing rule only to the shortlist.
5. Freeze the calibration winner before reporting 2017--2025.
6. Report the final strategy, costs, margin use, long/short attribution and
   the unconditional short-spread diagnostic.

The final rule is not chosen from the full-sample result. All alternative
2017--2025 results are descriptive appendix evidence and cannot revise the
frozen choice, which keeps model selection separate from OOS testing.

## Step 0: Computational Setup and Helper Functions

This section sets up the full computational environment for the
relative-value calendar-spread strategy. It loads all required packages, defines
the file paths for data inputs and strategy outputs, copies across every
helper function from the S&S 2000 Full Timeline code (unchanged), and
defines the strategy-level constants that govern the
entire backtest. No data are loaded and no estimates are produced in this
step.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# Find the project from the notebook location 
find_project_root <- function(start_path) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(start_path, mustWork = TRUE)

  for (i in 0:10) { 
    primary_data <- file.path(candidate, "data", "CL_weekly_full_with_underlying_v2.rds")
    fallback_data <- file.path(candidate, "data", "Old", "CL_weekly_full_with_underlying_v2.rds")
    if (file.exists(primary_data) || file.exists(fallback_data)) return(candidate)

    # This additional check covers an interactive session opened from the
    # outer thesis folder, one level above the R project used for the analysis.
    nested_project <- file.path(candidate, "MA Code ", "Master Thesis 1.1")
    nested_primary <- file.path(nested_project, "data", "CL_weekly_full_with_underlying_v2.rds")
    nested_fallback <- file.path(
      nested_project, "data", "Old", "CL_weekly_full_with_underlying_v2.rds"
    )
    if (file.exists(nested_primary) || file.exists(nested_fallback)) {
      return(normalizePath(nested_project, mustWork = TRUE))
    }

    parent <- dirname(candidate) # Move up one folder and stop at the file-system root.
    if (identical(parent, candidate)) break
    candidate <- parent
  }

  stop("Could not locate the Master Thesis 1.1 project folder from: ", start_path)
}

# Trading leg identifiers (row indices within CONTRACTS / Y / Tau)
# CL1 = row 1 (short leg), CL17 = row 5 (long leg)

IDX_CL17 <- 5L   # pos_L: -1 short, +1 long (opposite sign to pos_S always)

# Weekly time step in year units (exact, consistent with estimation code)
DELTA_T <- 7 / 365.25

# Sample boundaries

FIRST_TRADE  <- as.Date("2000-01-01")   # first week of out-of-sample trading

# Rebalancing is driven by calendar year boundaries in obs_dates (constructed in Step 2).
# No hardcoded week count; this makes the schedule robust to missing observations.

# This first pass reconstructs the unfiltered signal reference. The actual
# timing candidates and final strategy are evaluated later.
STRATEGY_ID    <- "SS2000_RawSignalReference"
STRATEGY_LABEL <- "SS2000 raw directional signal reference"
SIGNAL_RULE    <- "position = -sign(filtered chi)"
SIZING_RULE    <- "reference engine only; final sizing is evaluated later"
ENTRY_THRESHOLD <- NA_real_ # No threshold is used in the raw-signal reference.
EXIT_THRESHOLD  <- NA_real_ # Direction changes only when filtered chi changes sign.

# Contract specification
CONTRACT_SIZE   <- 1000L    # barrels per WTI futures contract

# Starting capital
INITIAL_CAPITAL <- 1e6     # USD

# Margin framework. The $6,750 maintenance estimate is based on the
# direction-specific CL1/CL17 no-offset requirement in CME's 26-Dec-2025
# historical margin schedule, rounded conservatively to the next $250.
# Initial margin applies CME's 110% HRP relationship and is rounded to $7,500.
# The overlay uses only a 2.0x stress multiplier and limits
# aggregate stressed margin to 80% of start-of-week equity.
MAINTENANCE_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD <- 6750
INITIAL_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD     <- 7500
MARGIN_STRESS_MULTIPLIER      <- 2.0
STRESS_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD      <- INITIAL_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD * MARGIN_STRESS_MULTIPLIER
MAX_STRESS_MARGIN_UTILIZATION <- 0.80

# ── Position sizing: entry-time spread-range normalization ───────────────────
#
# Contract count is set at each new trade entry using:
#
#   RANGE_BUDGET_PCT = SIZING_SCALE_PCT / sqrt(WEEKS_PER_YEAR)
#   n = clamp(round((RANGE_BUDGET_PCT * capital) / (spread_level_sd * CONTRACT_SIZE)),
#             N_CONTRACTS_MIN, N_CONTRACTS_MAX)
#
# spread_level_sd is the strictly lagged, 26-week-half-life EW standard
# deviation of the rolled executable spread LEVEL. It uses the complete
# available history through t-1, with exponentially declining weights.
#
# SIZING_SCALE_PCT / sqrt(52) keeps the 20% calibration visible while
# producing a 2.77% spread-range budget. The sqrt(52) term is a 
# calibration constant here; it does not annualise the spread-level.
#

SIZING_SCALE_PCT <- 0.20   # calibration scale used in 20% / sqrt(52)
WEEKS_PER_YEAR   <- 52L
RANGE_BUDGET_PCT <- SIZING_SCALE_PCT / sqrt(WEEKS_PER_YEAR)
N_CONTRACTS_MIN  <- 5L     # floor: always trade at least 5 spreads
N_CONTRACTS_MAX  <- 60L    # ceiling: cap at 60 spreads
EMA_LEVEL_HALF_LIFE <- 26L # half-life (weeks) for entry-time level dispersion

# Transaction costs: conservative all-in one-way execution cost on
# gross notional traded (both legs combined when both are transacted).
# Applied on entry, exit, resizing, flips, and leg rolls.
REFERENCE_TX_COST_BPS_ONE_WAY <- 0.0005

# Cost assumption used in the thesis: one-way dollar cost per contract-side.
# These fixed costs are used instead of the 5 bps convention above in
# every reported benchmark, candidate and final-strategy result below.
BASE_COST_CL1  <- 12.50 # Front contract: commission, spread and slippage.
BASE_COST_CL17 <- 22.50 # Less liquid deferred contract receives a larger cost.

# CME haircut on T-Bill collateral posted as performance bond margin
# Source: CME Clearing Acceptable Collateral schedule (T-Bills, 0 to ≤1 year)
TBILL_HAIRCUT <- 0.005   # 0.5%

# Multi-start count for MLE optimisation (matches estimation code)
N_STARTS <- 8L

# Development flag: set to TRUE to run a short test window only.
# Set to FALSE to run the full sample through 2025.

DEV_MODE <- FALSE

# STEP 0.4 — Custom print method for theta_hat objects
#
# Same as S&S 2000 Full Timeline.
# Hides sigma_obs_raw from printed output while keeping it in the object.
#############################################################################

print.theta_hat <- function(x, ...) {
  y <- x
  if ("sigma_obs_raw" %in% names(y)) y$sigma_obs_raw <- NULL
  old_class <- class(y)
  class(y) <- setdiff(old_class, "theta_hat")
  print(y, ...)
  invisible(x)
}

#############################################################################
# STEP 0.4b — Execution helper functions
#
# These helpers support the explicit underlying-contract execution layer.
# Signals remain defined on generic CL1 / CL17 contracts, while P&L and
# transaction costs are computed on the actual underlying futures tickers
# held through each weekly interval.
#############################################################################

generic_rank_from_name <- function(x) {
  as.integer(stringr::str_match(x, "^CL(\\d+) Comdty")[, 2])
}

sort_generic_cols <- function(cols) {
  cols[order(generic_rank_from_name(cols))]
}

match_ticker_index <- function(und_row, ticker) {
  idx <- which(!is.na(und_row) & und_row == ticker)
  if (length(idx) == 0L) NA_integer_ else idx[1L]
}

lookup_ticker_price <- function(px_row, und_row, ticker) {
  idx <- match_ticker_index(und_row, ticker)
  if (is.na(idx)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(px_row[idx])
}

lookup_ticker_ltd <- function(ltd_row, und_row, ticker) {
  idx <- match_ticker_index(und_row, ticker)
  if (is.na(idx)) return(as.Date(NA))
  val <- ltd_row[idx]
  if (inherits(val, "Date")) return(as.Date(val))
  if (is.numeric(val)) return(as.Date(val, origin = "1970-01-01"))
  as.Date(as.character(val))
}

next_ticker_in_ladder <- function(und_row, ticker) {
  idx <- match_ticker_index(und_row, ticker)
  if (is.na(idx)) return(NA_character_)
  later_idx <- which(!is.na(und_row) & seq_along(und_row) > idx)
  if (length(later_idx) == 0L) NA_character_ else und_row[later_idx[1L]]
}

choose_execution_ticker <- function(held_ticker, generic_ticker_next,
                                    prev_und_row, prev_ltd_row, next_obs_date) {
  advance_if_unsafe <- function(ticker) {
    if (is.na(ticker) || ticker == "") return(NA_character_)
    current_ticker <- ticker
    visited <- character()

    repeat {
      if (current_ticker %in% visited) {
        stop("Unsafe execution ladder cycle detected for ticker ", ticker)
      }
      visited <- c(visited, current_ticker)

      if (is.na(match_ticker_index(prev_und_row, current_ticker))) {
        stop("Ticker ", current_ticker, " not found in prior-week execution ladder")
      }

      ticker_ltd <- lookup_ticker_ltd(prev_ltd_row, prev_und_row, current_ticker)
      ticker_unsafe <- !is.na(ticker_ltd) && ticker_ltd <= next_obs_date
      if (!ticker_unsafe) return(current_ticker)

      next_ticker <- next_ticker_in_ladder(prev_und_row, current_ticker)
      if (is.na(next_ticker) || next_ticker == "") {
        stop("No safe successor found in execution ladder for ticker ", current_ticker)
      }
      current_ticker <- next_ticker
    }
  }

  if (is.na(generic_ticker_next) || generic_ticker_next == "") {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  if (is.na(held_ticker) || held_ticker == "") {
    return(advance_if_unsafe(generic_ticker_next))
  }

  if (is.na(match_ticker_index(prev_und_row, held_ticker))) {
    stop("Carried ticker ", held_ticker, " not found in prior-week execution ladder")
  }

  held_ltd <- lookup_ticker_ltd(prev_ltd_row, prev_und_row, held_ticker)
  generic_switch <- held_ticker != generic_ticker_next
  ltd_unsafe <- !is.na(held_ltd) && held_ltd <= next_obs_date

  if (generic_switch) {
    return(advance_if_unsafe(generic_ticker_next))
  }

  if (ltd_unsafe) {
    next_ticker <- next_ticker_in_ladder(prev_und_row, held_ticker)
    if (!is.na(next_ticker) && next_ticker != "") {
      return(next_ticker)
    }
    return(generic_ticker_next)
  }

  held_ticker
}

build_execution_spread_levels <- function(index_seq, obs_dates_vec,
                                          und_CL1_vec, und_CL17_vec,
                                          px_all_mat, und_all_mat, ltd_all_mat) {
  idx_seq <- as.integer(index_seq)
  idx_seq <- idx_seq[is.finite(idx_seq)]
  n_seq <- length(idx_seq)
  if (n_seq == 0L) return(numeric(0))

  spread_levels <- rep(NA_real_, n_seq)
  held_ticker_CL1 <- NA_character_
  held_ticker_CL17 <- NA_character_

  for (j in seq_len(n_seq)) {
    idx_now <- idx_seq[j]
    row_now_px  <- px_all_mat[idx_now, , drop = TRUE]
    row_now_und <- und_all_mat[idx_now, , drop = TRUE]
    row_now_ltd <- ltd_all_mat[idx_now, , drop = TRUE]

    next_obs_date <- if (j < n_seq) obs_dates_vec[idx_seq[j + 1L]] else
      (obs_dates_vec[idx_now] + 7)

    held_ticker_CL1 <- choose_execution_ticker(
      held_ticker = held_ticker_CL1,
      generic_ticker_next = und_CL1_vec[idx_now],
      prev_und_row = row_now_und,
      prev_ltd_row = row_now_ltd,
      next_obs_date = next_obs_date
    )

    held_ticker_CL17 <- choose_execution_ticker(
      held_ticker = held_ticker_CL17,
      generic_ticker_next = und_CL17_vec[idx_now],
      prev_und_row = row_now_und,
      prev_ltd_row = row_now_ltd,
      next_obs_date = next_obs_date
    )

    px_CL1_now <- lookup_ticker_price(row_now_px, row_now_und, held_ticker_CL1)
    px_CL17_now <- lookup_ticker_price(row_now_px, row_now_und, held_ticker_CL17)

    if (is.na(px_CL1_now) || is.na(px_CL17_now)) {
      stop("Missing execution-consistent spread price while building sizing series at index ", idx_now)
    }

    spread_levels[j] <- px_CL1_now - px_CL17_now
  }

  spread_levels
}

ema_sd <- function(x, half_life = EMA_LEVEL_HALF_LIFE) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 2L) return(NA_real_)

  lambda <- exp(log(0.5) / half_life)
  ages <- rev(seq_len(n) - 1L)
  w <- lambda^ages
  w <- w / sum(w)
  mu <- sum(w * x)
  sqrt(sum(w * (x - mu)^2))
}

build_entry_ema_level_sd_series <- function(spread_levels,
                                            half_life = EMA_LEVEL_HALF_LIFE) {
  n <- length(spread_levels)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  if (n <= 1L) return(out)

  for (i in 2:n) {
    out[i] <- ema_sd(spread_levels[1:(i - 1L)], half_life = half_life)
  }

  out
}

#############################################################################
# STEP 0.5 — Model helper functions
#
# Same as S&S 2000 Full Timeline (Steps 2 and 3).
# These are the exact same functions used for estimation, ensuring that the
# state-space system constructed during the forward filter in the strategy
# is identical to what was used during training.
#############################################################################

# ── A(T): maturity-dependent constant term in log futures pricing equation ──
# Equation (9) / A(T) in Schwartz & Smith (2000).
A_fun <- function(T, kappa, mu_star, sigma_chi, sigma_xi, rho, lambda_chi) {
  var_lnS <- (sigma_chi^2 / (2 * kappa)) * (1 - exp(-2 * kappa * T)) +
    sigma_xi^2 * T +
    2 * rho * sigma_chi * sigma_xi * (1 - exp(-kappa * T)) / kappa
  mu_star * T - (1 - exp(-kappa * T)) * (lambda_chi / kappa) + 0.5 * var_lnS
}

# ── W(Δt): discretised process noise covariance for state transition ────────
process_W <- function(Delta_t, kappa, sigma_chi, sigma_xi, rho) {
  var_chi    <- (sigma_chi^2 / (2 * kappa)) * (1 - exp(-2 * kappa * Delta_t))
  var_xi     <- sigma_xi^2 * Delta_t
  cov_chi_xi <- rho * sigma_chi * sigma_xi * (1 - exp(-kappa * Delta_t)) / kappa
  matrix(c(var_chi, cov_chi_xi,
           cov_chi_xi, var_xi), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
}

# ── make_ss_arrays(): build all FKF-ready state-space arrays ────────────────
# Constructs Zt (measurement matrix), ct (measurement intercept), GGt
# (measurement noise), Tt (transition matrix), dt (state drift), HHt
# (state noise) for a given theta and Tau matrix.
make_ss_arrays <- function(theta, Tau, Delta_t) {
  T_len <- ncol(Tau)
  m     <- nrow(Tau)
  n     <- 2L          # states: (chi, xi)

  with(as.list(theta), {

    Ft <- array(0, dim = c(m, n, T_len))
    d  <- matrix(0, nrow = m, ncol = T_len)

    for (tt in seq_len(T_len)) {
      tau_t      <- Tau[, tt]
      Ft[, , tt] <- cbind(exp(-kappa * tau_t), rep(1, m))
      d[, tt]    <- A_fun(tau_t, kappa, mu_star, sigma_chi, sigma_xi, rho, lambda_chi)
    }

    V <- diag(sigma_obs_vec^2, m)

    Tt  <- array(0, dim = c(n, n, T_len))
    dt  <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = T_len)
    HHt <- array(0, dim = c(n, n, T_len))

    for (tt in seq_len(T_len)) {
      G_t <- matrix(c(exp(-kappa * Delta_t), 0,
                      0,                     1),
                    nrow = n, byrow = TRUE)
      c_t <- c(0, mu * Delta_t)
      W_t <- process_W(Delta_t, kappa, sigma_chi, sigma_xi, rho)
      Tt[, , tt]  <- G_t
      dt[, tt]    <- c_t
      HHt[, , tt] <- W_t
    }

    list(
      Zt  = Ft,
      ct  = d,
      HHt = HHt,
      GGt = array(V, dim = c(m, m, T_len)),
      Tt  = Tt,
      dt  = dt
    )
  })
}

# ── apply_missing_mask_fkf(): handle NAs in Y for FKF ───────────────────────
# Missing observations are neutralised by zeroing out their rows in Zt/ct
# and inflating their measurement variance to a large number so the filter
# ignores them. Placeholder value of 0 is written into y_tilde.
apply_missing_mask_fkf <- function(Y, ss, big_var = NULL, big_var_mult = 1e6) {
  m     <- dim(ss$Zt)[1]
  T_len <- ncol(Y)

  y_tilde <- Y
  y_tilde[is.na(y_tilde)] <- 0

  Zt_new  <- ss$Zt
  ct_new  <- ss$ct
  GGt_new <- ss$GGt

  I <- diag(1, m)

  if (is.null(big_var)) {
    Vdiag <- diag(ss$GGt[, , 1])
    Vmed  <- median(Vdiag[is.finite(Vdiag) & Vdiag > 0])
    if (!is.finite(Vmed)) Vmed <- 1.0
    big_var <- big_var_mult * Vmed
  }

  for (tt in seq_len(T_len)) {
    miss         <- is.na(Y[, tt])
    M            <- diag(as.numeric(!miss), m, m)
    Zt_new[, , tt] <- M %*% Zt_new[, , tt]
    ct_new[, tt]   <- M %*% ct_new[, tt]
    V_base         <- GGt_new[, , tt]
    GGt_new[, , tt] <- M %*% V_base %*% M + (I - M) * big_var
  }

  list(yt  = y_tilde, Zt  = Zt_new, ct  = ct_new,
       GGt = GGt_new, Tt  = ss$Tt,  dt  = ss$dt, HHt = ss$HHt)
}

# ── softplus(): smooth R → R+ transform for measurement error parameters ────
softplus <- function(x) log1p(exp(-abs(x))) + pmax(x, 0)

# ── pack(): map theta list → unconstrained optimizer vector ─────────────────
pack <- function(theta) c(
  log(theta$kappa),
  theta$mu,
  theta$mu_star,
  log(theta$sigma_chi),
  log(theta$sigma_xi),
  atanh(theta$rho),
  theta$lambda_chi,
  theta$sigma_obs_raw
)

# ── unpack(): map optimizer vector → theta list (natural scale) ──────────────
unpack <- function(p) {
  if (length(p) < 8L) stop("unpack(): parameter vector too short (need >= 8 elements).")
  sigma_obs_raw <- as.numeric(p[8:length(p)])
  eps_sd        <- 1e-8
  list(
    kappa         = exp(p[1]),
    mu            = p[2],
    mu_star       = p[3],
    sigma_chi     = exp(p[4]),
    sigma_xi      = exp(p[5]),
    rho           = tanh(p[6]),
    lambda_chi    = p[7],
    sigma_obs_raw = sigma_obs_raw,
    sigma_obs_vec = softplus(sigma_obs_raw) + eps_sd
  )
}

# ── sample_start(): randomised but economically plausible starting values ───
# Called N_STARTS times in the MLE routine; identical to estimation code.
sample_start <- function() {
  sigma_obs_raw0 <- rnorm(length(CONTRACTS), mean = 0.12, sd = 0.10)
  list(
    kappa         = runif(1, 0.5, 5),
    mu            = runif(1, -0.10, 0.10),
    mu_star       = runif(1, -0.10, 0.10),
    sigma_chi     = runif(1, 0.05, 0.5),
    sigma_xi      = runif(1, 0.05, 0.5),
    rho           = runif(1, -0.95, 0.95),
    lambda_chi    = runif(1, -1, 1),
    sigma_obs_raw = sigma_obs_raw0
  )
}

# ── compute_prior_from_first_L(): data-based Kalman prior ───────────────────
# Pools the first L measurement equations (after removing A(tau) intercepts)
# and estimates initial (chi0, xi0) by OLS. Falls back to a diffuse prior if
# there is insufficient early data — critical for the first training block.
compute_prior_from_first_L <- function(Zt, ct, yt, L = 6, inflate = 2.0, nugget = 1e-8) {
  L <- min(L, ncol(yt))
  stopifnot(L >= 2)

  X_stack <- NULL
  y_stack <- NULL

  for (t in seq_len(L)) {
    Ft_full <- Zt[, , t]
    dtvec   <- ct[, t]
    yvec    <- yt[, t]
    obs     <- rowSums(abs(Ft_full)) > 0
    if (sum(obs) < 2L) next
    Ft      <- Ft_full[obs, , drop = FALSE]
    yy      <- as.vector(yvec[obs] - dtvec[obs])
    X_stack <- rbind(X_stack, Ft)
    y_stack <- c(y_stack, yy)
  }

  if (is.null(X_stack) || length(y_stack) < 6L) {
    return(list(m0 = c(0, 0), P0 = diag(1e6, 2)))
  }

  fit <- lm.fit(x = X_stack, y = y_stack)
  m0  <- as.vector(fit$coefficients)

  if (any(!is.finite(m0))) {
    return(list(m0 = c(0, 0), P0 = diag(1e6, 2)))
  }

  n_obs   <- length(y_stack)
  p_dim   <- ncol(X_stack)
  rss     <- sum(fit$residuals^2)
  s2      <- rss / max(1, n_obs - p_dim)

  XtX_inv <- tryCatch(
    solve(crossprod(X_stack) + diag(nugget, p_dim)),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(XtX_inv) || any(!is.finite(XtX_inv))) {
    P0 <- diag(1e6, 2)
  } else {
    P0 <- inflate * (s2 * XtX_inv + diag(nugget, p_dim))
    if (any(!is.finite(P0)) || det(P0) <= 0) P0 <- diag(1e6, 2)
  }

  list(m0 = m0, P0 = P0)
}

# ── loglik(): negative log-likelihood for optim() ───────────────────────────
# Identical to the estimation code. Takes the packed optimizer vector p,
# builds the state-space system, applies the missing mask, initialises the
# prior, runs the Kalman filter, and returns the negative log-likelihood.
loglik <- function(p, Y, Tau, Delta_t) {
  theta  <- unpack(p)
  ss     <- make_ss_arrays(theta, Tau, Delta_t)
  if (any(!is.finite(ss$ct))) return(1e6)
  masked <- apply_missing_mask_fkf(Y, ss)
  L_use  <- max(4L, min(6L, ncol(Y)))
  prior  <- tryCatch(
    compute_prior_from_first_L(masked$Zt, masked$ct, masked$yt,
                               L = L_use, inflate = 2.0),
    error = function(e) list(m0 = c(0, 0), P0 = diag(1e6, 2))
  )
  kf <- tryCatch(
    fkf(a0  = prior$m0,  P0  = prior$P0,
        dt  = masked$dt, ct  = masked$ct,
        Tt  = masked$Tt, Zt  = masked$Zt,
        HHt = masked$HHt, GGt = masked$GGt,
        yt  = masked$yt),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(kf) || !is.finite(kf$logLik)) return(1e6)
  -kf$logLik
}

#############################################################################
# STEP 0.6 — Sanity check: verify all required functions exist
#############################################################################

required_fns <- c(
  "A_fun", "process_W", "make_ss_arrays", "apply_missing_mask_fkf",
  "softplus", "pack", "unpack", "sample_start",
  "compute_prior_from_first_L", "loglik"
)

setup_env <- environment()
missing_fns <- required_fns[
  !vapply(required_fns, function(fn) {
    exists(fn, envir = setup_env, mode = "function", inherits = TRUE)
  }, logical(1))
]

if (length(missing_fns) > 0L) {
  stop("Step 0 incomplete — the following functions are missing: ",
       paste(missing_fns, collapse = ", "))
} else {
  message("✓ Step 0 complete — all ", length(required_fns),
          " helper functions loaded successfully.")
  message("✓ Strategy constants set:")
  message("    Training start     : ", TRAIN_START)
  message("    First trade        : ", FIRST_TRADE)
  message("    Strategy            : ", STRATEGY_LABEL)
  message("    Signal rule         : ", SIGNAL_RULE)
  message("    Initial capital    : $", format(INITIAL_CAPITAL, big.mark = ","))
  message("    Sizing rule         : ", SIZING_RULE)
  message("    Range budget       : ", SIZING_SCALE_PCT * 100,
          "% / sqrt(", WEEKS_PER_YEAR, ") = ",
          round(RANGE_BUDGET_PCT * 100, 3), "% of capital per level SD")
  message("    EMA half-life      : ", EMA_LEVEL_HALF_LIFE, " weeks")
  message("    Contracts range    : [", N_CONTRACTS_MIN, ", ", N_CONTRACTS_MAX, "]")
  message("    Maintenance margin : $", format(MAINTENANCE_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD, big.mark = ","),
          " per spread")
  message("    Initial margin     : $", format(INITIAL_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD, big.mark = ","),
          " per spread")
  message("    Stress rule        : ", MARGIN_STRESS_MULTIPLIER, "x initial, capped at ",
          MAX_STRESS_MARGIN_UTILIZATION * 100, "% of start equity")
  message("    DEV_MODE           : ", DEV_MODE,
          if (DEV_MODE) paste0(" (through ", DEV_END, ")") else "")
  message("    Contracts          : ", paste(CONTRACTS, collapse = ", "))
}

```

## Step 1: Data Loading, Matrix Construction and Roll Flags

This section loads all data required for the strategy. The futures data
loading and matrix construction (Y, Tau, obs_dates) is identical to
S&S 2000 Full Timeline, using the same .rds file, same column
conventions, same CL1 edge-case fix, same NA masking logic. After
building those matrices the section adds three things the estimation
code did not need: a subsetting of all matrices to the 1990 training
start, construction of binary roll flags for CL1 and CL17, and loading
of the DTB3 T-bill rate aligned to obs_dates.

```{r step1, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

#############################################################################
# STEP 1.0 — Load Bloomberg futures data
# Identical to S&S 2000 Full Timeline Step 1.0
#############################################################################

weekly_full <- readr::read_rds(PATH_FUTURES) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(date))

# Column name vectors for the 5-contract signal set (built from CONTRACTS)
needed_px  <- paste0(CONTRACTS, "__PX")
needed_und <- paste0(CONTRACTS, "__UND")
needed_ltd <- paste0(CONTRACTS, "__LTD")

# Full generic ladder used by the underlying-contract execution engine.
all_px_cols  <- sort_generic_cols(grep("__PX$",  names(weekly_full), value = TRUE))
all_und_cols <- sort_generic_cols(grep("__UND$", names(weekly_full), value = TRUE))
all_ltd_cols <- sort_generic_cols(grep("__LTD$", names(weekly_full), value = TRUE))

# Safety: verify all required columns exist
stopifnot(all(needed_px  %in% names(weekly_full)))
stopifnot(all(needed_ltd %in% names(weekly_full)))
stopifnot(all(needed_und %in% names(weekly_full)))
stopifnot(length(all_px_cols)  == length(all_und_cols))
stopifnot(length(all_px_cols)  == length(all_ltd_cols))

# Sort by date — defensive, should already be sorted
weekly_win <- weekly_full %>%
  dplyr::arrange(date)

# Full price / UND / LTD ladders by date, required for explicit held-contract
# execution. Rows are dates; columns are generic maturity slots CL1...CL120.
PX_ALL_full <- weekly_win %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(all_px_cols)) %>%
  as.matrix()
storage.mode(PX_ALL_full) <- "double"

UND_ALL_full <- weekly_win %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(all_und_cols)) %>%
  as.matrix()

LTD_ALL_full <- weekly_win %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(all_ltd_cols)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.character)) %>%
  as.matrix()

#############################################################################
# STEP 1.1 — Build log-price observation matrix Y
# Identical to S&S 2000 Full Timeline Step 1.1
# Rows = contracts (CL1, CL5, CL9, CL13, CL17), Cols = observation dates
#############################################################################

weekly_log <- weekly_win %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    obs_date = date,
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::all_of(needed_px),
      ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), NA_real_, log(as.numeric(.x))),
      .names = "log_{.col}"
    )
  )

Y_full <- weekly_log %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::starts_with("log_")) %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t()

storage.mode(Y_full) <- "double"

obs_dates_full <- weekly_log$obs_date
colnames(Y_full) <- as.character(obs_dates_full)

#############################################################################
# STEP 1.2 — Build time-to-maturity matrix Tau
# Identical to S&S 2000 Full Timeline Step 1.2
# Tau_{i,t} = (LTD_{i,t} - obs_date_t) / 365.25
#############################################################################

LTD_df <- weekly_win %>%
  dplyr::select(date, dplyr::all_of(needed_ltd))

LTD_mat <- LTD_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-date) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.Date)) %>%
  as.matrix()

Tau_full <- matrix(NA_real_,
                   nrow = length(CONTRACTS),
                   ncol = length(obs_dates_full))
rownames(Tau_full) <- CONTRACTS
colnames(Tau_full) <- as.character(obs_dates_full)

for (j in seq_along(obs_dates_full)) {
  tdate   <- obs_dates_full[j]
  ltd_vec <- as.Date(LTD_mat[j, ])
  tau_vec <- as.numeric(ltd_vec - tdate) / 365.25
  tau_vec[is.na(ltd_vec) | tau_vec <= 0] <- NA_real_
  Tau_full[, j] <- tau_vec
}

#############################################################################
# STEP 1.3 — CL1 edge-case fix + NA cleanup
# Identical to S&S 2000 Full Timeline Step 1.3
#############################################################################

# CL1 row indices (same in both Y and Tau; contracts are in the same order)
cl1_row_Y   <- which(rownames(Y_full)   == paste0("log_", CONTRACTS[IDX_CL1], "__PX"))
cl1_row_Tau <- IDX_CL1   # = 1

stopifnot(length(cl1_row_Y) == 1L)

# Weeks where CL1 is on or past its LTD; drop the observation, keep Tau = 0
bad_cl1 <- which(is.na(Tau_full[cl1_row_Tau, ]) | Tau_full[cl1_row_Tau, ] <= 0)
Y_full[cl1_row_Y, bad_cl1]      <- NA_real_
Tau_full[cl1_row_Tau, bad_cl1]  <- 0        # keep finite for make_ss_arrays()

# Propagate: wherever Tau is NA, Y must also be NA
Y_full[is.na(Tau_full)] <- NA_real_

# Replace all remaining NA in Tau with 0 (required by make_ss_arrays)
Tau_full[is.na(Tau_full)] <- 0

#############################################################################
# STEP 1.4 — Build roll flags for CL1 and CL17
#
# A roll occurs when the Bloomberg underlying ticker (UND) changes from one
# week to the next. The flag is 1 on the FIRST week of the new contract
# (the week Bloomberg has already switched). Flag is stored for every date
# in the full history, we subset it alongside Y and Tau in Step 2.
#
# These flags are used later in compute_pnl() to charge realistic roll
# transaction costs whenever the underlying contract behind CL1 or CL17
# changes while the strategy is in a position.
#############################################################################

und_cl1  <- weekly_win[[needed_und[IDX_CL1]]]   # UND column for CL1
und_cl17 <- weekly_win[[needed_und[IDX_CL17]]]  # UND column for CL17

# Roll = 1 when ticker differs from prior week; first observation = 0 (no prior)
roll_CL1_full  <- as.integer(c(FALSE, und_cl1[-1]  != und_cl1[-length(und_cl1)]))
roll_CL17_full <- as.integer(c(FALSE, und_cl17[-1] != und_cl17[-length(und_cl17)]))

# Guard against NA in UND columns producing spurious roll flags
roll_CL1_full[is.na(und_cl1)  | c(FALSE, is.na(und_cl1[-length(und_cl1)]))]  <- NA_integer_
roll_CL17_full[is.na(und_cl17)| c(FALSE, is.na(und_cl17[-length(und_cl17)]))] <- NA_integer_

#############################################################################
# STEP 1.5 — Load and align DTB3 T-bill rate
#
# Source: FRED series DTB3, sheet "Weekly, Ending Friday"
# Rate is annualised percent (e.g. 5.25 = 5.25% p.a.), discount basis.
# We forward-fill any missing weeks (holiday gaps) then align to obs_dates_full.
#############################################################################

dtb3_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(PATH_TBILL, sheet = "Weekly, Ending Friday") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    date  = as.Date(observation_date),
    dtb3  = as.numeric(DTB3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(date)

# Forward-fill any NA rates (FRED occasionally has gaps on holiday weeks)
dtb3_raw <- dtb3_raw %>%
  tidyr::fill(dtb3, .direction = "down")

# Align to obs_dates_full via a left join; futures dates are the master
# For any futures date with no exact T-bill match, carry forward the
# most recent available rate (rolling join using dplyr + fill)
tbill_aligned <- dplyr::tibble(date = obs_dates_full) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dtb3_raw, by = "date") %>%
  tidyr::fill(dtb3, .direction = "down")

dtb3_full <- tbill_aligned$dtb3   # length = length(obs_dates_full)

#############################################################################
# STEP 1.6 — Subset everything to TRAIN_START (1990-01-05)
#
# The full matrices go back to 1984 but CL17 has gaps before 1990.
# All strategy work uses only obs_dates >= TRAIN_START.
# We keep _full objects intact and create clean _strat objects for all steps.
#############################################################################

strat_idx <- which(obs_dates_full >= TRAIN_START)

obs_dates  <- obs_dates_full[strat_idx]          # master date vector from here on
Y          <- Y_full[,   strat_idx, drop = FALSE] # 5 x T_strat log-price matrix
Tau        <- Tau_full[, strat_idx, drop = FALSE] # 5 x T_strat maturity matrix
roll_CL1   <- roll_CL1_full[strat_idx]            # length T_strat roll flag
roll_CL17  <- roll_CL17_full[strat_idx]           # length T_strat roll flag
dtb3       <- dtb3_full[strat_idx]                # length T_strat T-bill rate
PX_ALL     <- PX_ALL_full[strat_idx,  , drop = FALSE]
UND_ALL    <- UND_ALL_full[strat_idx, , drop = FALSE]
LTD_ALL    <- LTD_ALL_full[strat_idx, , drop = FALSE]

# Also extract raw dollar prices for CL1 and CL17,  needed for P&L calculation
# and for the signal/spread plots (Kalman filter uses log prices; P&L uses the
# actual held underlying contracts via PX_ALL / UND_ALL / LTD_ALL).
price_CL1  <- as.numeric(weekly_win[[needed_px[IDX_CL1]]][strat_idx])
price_CL17 <- as.numeric(weekly_win[[needed_px[IDX_CL17]]][strat_idx])
und_CL1    <- weekly_win[[needed_und[IDX_CL1]]][strat_idx]
und_CL17   <- weekly_win[[needed_und[IDX_CL17]]][strat_idx]
ltd_CL1    <- as.Date(weekly_win[[needed_ltd[IDX_CL1]]][strat_idx])
ltd_CL17   <- as.Date(weekly_win[[needed_ltd[IDX_CL17]]][strat_idx])

#############################################################################
# STEP 1.7 — Sanity checks
#############################################################################

# 1. Dimension consistency
stopifnot(ncol(Y)   == length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(ncol(Tau) == length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(length(roll_CL1)  == length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(length(roll_CL17) == length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(length(dtb3)      == length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(length(price_CL1) == length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(length(price_CL17)== length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(nrow(PX_ALL)      == length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(nrow(UND_ALL)     == length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(nrow(LTD_ALL)     == length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(length(und_CL1)   == length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(length(und_CL17)  == length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(length(ltd_CL1)   == length(obs_dates))
stopifnot(length(ltd_CL17)  == length(obs_dates))

# 2. Date range
stopifnot(min(obs_dates) >= TRAIN_START)

# 3. No non-finite values in Tau (make_ss_arrays requires this)
stopifnot(all(is.finite(Tau)))

# 4. T-bill rate: no NAs after forward-fill
n_tbill_na <- sum(is.na(dtb3))
if (n_tbill_na > 0L) {
  warning("DTB3 has ", n_tbill_na, " NAs after forward-fill — check date alignment.")
}

# 5. Roll flag counts 
n_rolls_CL1  <- sum(roll_CL1  == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)
n_rolls_CL17 <- sum(roll_CL17 == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)

# 6. Weekly gap check on strategy subsample
dt_days <- as.numeric(diff(obs_dates))
gaps_ok <- all(dt_days == 7L)

#############################################################################
# STEP 1.8 — Confirmation messages
#############################################################################

message("✓ Step 1 complete")
message("  Strategy sample   : ", min(obs_dates), " → ", max(obs_dates))
message("  Total weeks       : ", length(obs_dates))
message("  Y dimensions      : ", nrow(Y), " contracts × ", ncol(Y), " weeks")
message("  Tau non-finite    : ", sum(!is.finite(Tau)), " (must be 0)")
message("  T-bill NAs        : ", n_tbill_na, " (must be 0)")
message("  DTB3 range        : ", round(min(dtb3, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        "% – ", round(max(dtb3, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "%")
message("  CL1  rolls        : ", n_rolls_CL1)
message("  CL17 rolls        : ", n_rolls_CL17)
message("  Full ladder cols   : ", ncol(PX_ALL))
message("  All gaps = 7 days : ", gaps_ok)

```

## Step 2: Rebalancing Schedule

This section constructs the complete rebalancing schedule that drives
the outer loop in Step 7. Rebalancing is anchored to calendar year
boundaries read directly from obs_dates, no hardcoded week counts. For
each block the schedule records the integer indices into obs_dates for
the training window end, the trading window start, and the trading
window end. DEV_MODE is applied here, truncating the schedule to DEV_END
before any estimation begins.

```{r step2, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

#############################################################################
# STEP 2.0 — Apply DEV_MODE truncation
#
# If DEV_MODE = TRUE, we restrict obs_dates (and all aligned vectors) to
# dates up to and including DEV_END. This does NOT reload any data —
# it simply shortens the working vectors that all downstream steps use.
# To switch to the full sample, set DEV_MODE <- FALSE in Step 0 and rerun.
#############################################################################

if (DEV_MODE) {
  dev_idx    <- which(obs_dates <= DEV_END)
  obs_dates  <- obs_dates[dev_idx]
  Y          <- Y[,    dev_idx, drop = FALSE]
  Tau        <- Tau[,  dev_idx, drop = FALSE]
  roll_CL1   <- roll_CL1[dev_idx]
  roll_CL17  <- roll_CL17[dev_idx]
  dtb3       <- dtb3[dev_idx]
  price_CL1  <- price_CL1[dev_idx]
  price_CL17 <- price_CL17[dev_idx]
  und_CL1    <- und_CL1[dev_idx]
  und_CL17   <- und_CL17[dev_idx]
  ltd_CL1    <- ltd_CL1[dev_idx]
  ltd_CL17   <- ltd_CL17[dev_idx]
  PX_ALL     <- PX_ALL[dev_idx,  , drop = FALSE]
  UND_ALL    <- UND_ALL[dev_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  LTD_ALL    <- LTD_ALL[dev_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  message("DEV_MODE = TRUE — sample truncated to ", min(obs_dates), " → ", max(obs_dates))
} else {
  message("DEV_MODE = FALSE — using full sample ", min(obs_dates), " → ", max(obs_dates))
}

#############################################################################
# STEP 2.1 — Identify trading years from obs_dates
#
# Trading years are all calendar years in obs_dates that are >= year(FIRST_TRADE).
# Each trading year t uses:
#   - Training window : all obs_dates from TRAIN_START through end of year t-1
#   - Trading window  : all obs_dates where year(obs_date) == t
#
# We derive everything from the actual dates in obs_dates, so missing weeks
# or irregular gaps never cause the schedule to drift.
#############################################################################

all_years      <- lubridate::year(obs_dates)
trading_years  <- sort(unique(all_years[obs_dates >= FIRST_TRADE]))

stopifnot(length(trading_years) >= 1L)

#############################################################################
# STEP 2.2 — Build the schedule data frame
#
# One row per trading year. All columns are integer indices into obs_dates
# (and therefore into Y, Tau, price_CL1, price_CL17, roll_*, dtb3).
#
# Columns:
#   trading_year     : calendar year being traded (e.g. 2000)
#   train_start_idx  : first index of training window (always 1 = TRAIN_START)
#   train_end_idx    : last index where year < trading_year
#   trade_start_idx  : first index where year == trading_year
#   trade_end_idx    : last index where year == trading_year
#   n_train_weeks    : number of training observations
#   n_trade_weeks    : number of trading observations
#############################################################################

schedule <- purrr::map_dfr(trading_years, function(yr) {

  # Training window: TRAIN_START up to and including last week of year yr-1
  train_idx  <- which(all_years < yr)

  # Trading window: all weeks in calendar year yr
  trade_idx  <- which(all_years == yr)

  # Both must be non-empty — if not, this year cannot be traded
  if (length(train_idx) == 0L || length(trade_idx) == 0L) return(NULL)

  dplyr::tibble(
    trading_year    = yr,
    train_start_idx = min(train_idx),   # always index 1 (TRAIN_START) — expanding window
    train_end_idx   = max(train_idx),   # last week before this trading year
    trade_start_idx = min(trade_idx),   # first week of this trading year
    trade_end_idx   = max(trade_idx),   # last week of this trading year
    n_train_weeks   = length(train_idx),
    n_trade_weeks   = length(trade_idx)
  )
})

stopifnot(nrow(schedule) >= 1L)

# Verify expanding window property: train_end_idx must strictly increase
stopifnot(all(diff(schedule$train_end_idx) > 0L))

# Verify no overlap between training and trading windows
stopifnot(all(schedule$train_end_idx < schedule$trade_start_idx))

# Verify contiguous trading windows (trade_end of year k+1 > trade_end of year k)
stopifnot(all(diff(schedule$trade_end_idx) > 0L))

#############################################################################
# STEP 2.3 — Confirmation messages
#############################################################################

message("✓ Step 2 complete — rebalancing schedule built")
message("  Trading years     : ", min(schedule$trading_year),
        " → ", max(schedule$trading_year),
        "  (", nrow(schedule), " blocks)")
message("  Training weeks    : ",
        min(schedule$n_train_weeks), " (block 1) → ",
        max(schedule$n_train_weeks), " (block ", nrow(schedule), ")")
message("  Trading weeks/yr  : ",
        min(schedule$n_trade_weeks), " – ",
        max(schedule$n_trade_weeks))
message("")
message("  Schedule preview:")

# Print the full schedule cleanly
print(
  schedule %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      train_start_date = obs_dates[train_start_idx],
      train_end_date   = obs_dates[train_end_idx],
      trade_start_date = obs_dates[trade_start_idx],
      trade_end_date   = obs_dates[trade_end_idx]
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      trading_year,
      train_start_date, train_end_date, n_train_weeks,
      trade_start_date, trade_end_date, n_trade_weeks
    ),
  n = Inf
)

```

## Step 3: Parameter Estimation Function

This section wraps the MLE estimation logic from
S&S 2000 Full Timeline into a single callable function
estimate_ss(). The function takes a training window subset of Y and Tau,
runs the multi-start BFGS optimisation, and returns the best theta_hat.
It is called once per rebalancing block in the outer loop (Step 7). The
estimation logic is identical to the S&S 2000 Full Timeline code; only the function
interface differs.

```{r step3, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

#############################################################################
# STEP 3.0 — estimate_ss(): MLE estimation for one training window
#
# Arguments:
#   Y_train   : 5 x n_train log-price matrix (subset of Y)
#   Tau_train : 5 x n_train maturity matrix (subset of Tau)
#   Delta_t   : weekly time step in years (= DELTA_T from Step 0)
#   n_starts  : number of random restarts for the optimiser (= N_STARTS)
#   block_id  : integer label for the block (used only in messages)
#
# Returns a theta_hat list with class "theta_hat", identical in structure
# to theta_hat_SS_FullTimeline_V2.0 from the estimation code, plus:
#   $loglik_converged  : best converged log-likelihood value
#   $n_valid_runs      : number of optimiser runs that converged
#   $lambda_xi_implied : mu - mu_star (long-run risk premium implied value)
#############################################################################

estimate_ss <- function(Y_train, Tau_train, Delta_t, n_starts, block_id) {

  stopifnot(ncol(Y_train) == ncol(Tau_train))
  stopifnot(nrow(Y_train) == nrow(Tau_train))
  stopifnot(ncol(Y_train) >= 10L)   # need enough data to identify 2 factors

  message("  [Block ", block_id, "] Starting MLE — ",
          ncol(Y_train), " training weeks, ", n_starts, " restarts")

  # ── 1. Generate random starting vectors ───────────────────────────────────
  set.seed(42L + block_id)   # reproducible per block; different seed each block
  init_vecs <- replicate(n_starts, pack(sample_start()), simplify = FALSE)

  # ── 2. Run optimiser from each starting point ─────────────────────────────
  fits <- purrr::map(init_vecs, function(p0) {
    tryCatch(
      optim(
        par     = p0,
        fn      = loglik,
        Y       = Y_train,
        Tau     = Tau_train,
        Delta_t = Delta_t,
        method  = "BFGS",
        control = list(maxit = 4000L, reltol = 1e-10)
      ),
      error = function(e) list(value = Inf, par = p0, convergence = 99L)
    )
  })

  # ── 3. Remove degenerate runs ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  is_plausible <- function(fit) {
    if (!is.finite(fit$value) || fit$value >= 1e5) return(FALSE)
    th <- tryCatch(unpack(fit$par), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(th)) return(FALSE)
    th$kappa      > 0   && th$kappa      <= 50  &&
    th$sigma_chi  > 0   && th$sigma_chi  <=  5  &&
    th$sigma_xi   > 0   && th$sigma_xi   <=  5  &&
    abs(th$rho)   < 0.9999                       &&
    all(is.finite(th$sigma_obs_vec))             &&
    all(th$sigma_obs_vec > 0)
  }

  valid <- purrr::keep(fits, is_plausible)

  if (length(valid) == 0L) {
    message("  [Block ", block_id, "] WARNING: all ", n_starts,
            " runs degenerate, retrying with 16 tighter starts ...")
    set.seed(42L + block_id + 1000L)
    init_vecs_retry <- replicate(16L, pack(sample_start()), simplify = FALSE)
    fits_retry <- purrr::map(init_vecs_retry, function(p0) {
      tryCatch(
        optim(par = p0, fn = loglik, Y = Y_train, Tau = Tau_train,
              Delta_t = Delta_t, method = "BFGS",
              control = list(maxit = 4000L, reltol = 1e-10)),
        error = function(e) list(value = Inf, par = p0, convergence = 99L)
      )
    })
    valid <- purrr::keep(fits_retry, is_plausible)
    if (length(valid) == 0L) {
      stop("Block ", block_id, ": estimation failed after retry. ",
           "Check training data for this window.")
    }
  }

  # ── 4. Select the run with the highest log-likelihood ─────────────────────
  best <- valid[[which.min(purrr::map_dbl(valid, "value"))]]

  # ── 5. Unpack to natural scale and attach metadata ─────────────────────────
  theta_hat <- unpack(best$par)
  class(theta_hat) <- "theta_hat"

  theta_hat$loglik_converged  <- -best$value
  theta_hat$n_valid_runs      <- length(valid)
  theta_hat$lambda_xi_implied <- theta_hat$mu - theta_hat$mu_star

  # ── Extract final filtered state from training window ──────────────────────
  # Run one clean forward filter pass at the final theta_hat over the full
  # training window. The December posterior is retained for the boundary
  # signal, while FKF's one-step-ahead prediction becomes the prior for the
  # first January observation.
  # This is fully look-ahead free (it only uses training data).
  ss_train   <- make_ss_arrays(theta_hat, Tau_train, Delta_t)
  masked_train <- apply_missing_mask_fkf(Y_train, ss_train)
  L_use      <- max(4L, min(6L, ncol(Y_train)))
  prior_train <- tryCatch(
    compute_prior_from_first_L(masked_train$Zt, masked_train$ct,
                               masked_train$yt, L = L_use, inflate = 2.0),
    error = function(e) list(m0 = c(0, 0), P0 = diag(1e6, 2))
  )
  kf_train <- tryCatch(
    fkf(a0  = prior_train$m0,  P0  = prior_train$P0,
        dt  = masked_train$dt, ct  = masked_train$ct,
        Tt  = masked_train$Tt, Zt  = masked_train$Zt,
        HHt = masked_train$HHt, GGt = masked_train$GGt,
        yt  = masked_train$yt),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.null(kf_train) && all(is.finite(kf_train$att))) {
    n_train <- ncol(Y_train)
    theta_hat$att_train_end <- as.numeric(kf_train$att[,  n_train])
    theta_hat$Ptt_train_end <- kf_train$Ptt[,, n_train]
    theta_hat$at_trade_start <- as.numeric(kf_train$at[, n_train + 1L])
    theta_hat$Pt_trade_start <- kf_train$Pt[, , n_train + 1L]
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(theta_hat$at_trade_start)))
    stopifnot(all(is.finite(theta_hat$Pt_trade_start)))
    # Empirical SD of filtered chi over the entire training window.
    # Used in generate_signals() as the z-score normaliser (Option B).
    # Look-ahead free: computed entirely from training data.
    chi_train_vec           <- as.numeric(kf_train$att[1L, ])
    emp_sd                  <- sd(chi_train_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
    theta_hat$sigma_chi_emp <- if (is.finite(emp_sd) && emp_sd > 0) emp_sd else NA_real_
  } else {
    # Fallback to diffuse prior if filter fails (should never happen)
    warning("Block ", block_id, ": training-end filter failed, using diffuse prior")
    theta_hat$att_train_end <- c(0, 0)
    theta_hat$Ptt_train_end <- diag(1e6, 2)
    theta_hat$at_trade_start <- c(0, 0)
    theta_hat$Pt_trade_start <- diag(1e6, 2)
    theta_hat$sigma_chi_emp <- NA_real_
  }

  message("  [Block ", block_id, "] MLE done — logLik = ",
          round(theta_hat$loglik_converged, 2),
          "  (", length(valid), "/", n_starts, " runs valid)")
  message("  [Block ", block_id, "] kappa = ",   round(theta_hat$kappa,     3),
          "  sigma_chi = ", round(theta_hat$sigma_chi, 3),
          "  sigma_xi = ",  round(theta_hat$sigma_xi,  3),
          "  rho = ",       round(theta_hat$rho,       3))
  message("  [Block ", block_id, "] Training-end state: chi = ",
          round(theta_hat$att_train_end[1], 4),
          "  xi = ", round(theta_hat$att_train_end[2], 4))
  message("  [Block ", block_id, "] First-trade-week prior: chi = ",
          round(theta_hat$at_trade_start[1], 4),
          "  xi = ", round(theta_hat$at_trade_start[2], 4))

  theta_hat
}

```

## Step 4: Forward Kalman Filter Function

This section defines run_forward_kf(), which takes a fixed theta_hat
from Step 3 and runs the Kalman filter forward over one trading year. It
extracts the filtered chi and xi paths used to construct the trading
signal in Step 5, and returns the final filtered state and covariance to
be carried forward as the prior for the next trading year.

```{r step4, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

#############################################################################
# STEP 4.0 — run_forward_kf(): forward Kalman filter for one trading year
#
# Arguments:
#   theta_hat  : parameter list returned by estimate_ss() (Step 3)
#   Y_trade    : 5 x n_trade log-price matrix for the trading window
#   Tau_trade  : 5 x n_trade maturity matrix for the trading window
#   Delta_t    : weekly time step in years (= DELTA_T from Step 0)
#   m0_init    : 2x1 one-step-ahead prior mean for the first trading week,
#                  obtained from at[, n_train + 1] under this year's theta.
#   P0_init    : 2x2 one-step-ahead prior covariance for the first trading week,
#                  obtained from Pt[,, n_train + 1] under this year's theta.
#   block_id   : integer label used in messages only
#
# Returns a list:
#   $chi_vec    : numeric vector length n_trade; filtered chi at each week
#                 = fkf$att[1, ]; posterior mean of chi given all data up to t
#   $xi_vec     : numeric vector length n_trade; filtered xi at each week
#                 = fkf$att[2, ]
#   $att_last   : numeric 2x1; filtered state at final week of trading year
#   $Ptt_last   : numeric 2x2; filtered covariance at final week of trading year
#   $kf         : the full fkf object (stored for diagnostics)
#
# Critical look-ahead bias note:
#   att[, t] is the POSTERIOR mean E[x_t | y_1,...,y_t], it uses week t data
#   but nothing from week t+1 onwards. The signal formed from chi_vec[t] is
#   applied to the price change during week t+1. This is correct and
#   look-ahead free. We never use at[, t] (the PRIOR, E[x_t | y_1,...,y_{t-1}])
#   which would be less accurate, or any smoothed state which would look ahead.
#############################################################################

run_forward_kf <- function(theta_hat, Y_trade, Tau_trade, Delta_t,
                           m0_init, P0_init, block_id) {

  stopifnot(ncol(Y_trade) == ncol(Tau_trade))
  stopifnot(length(m0_init) == 2L)
  stopifnot(all(dim(P0_init) == c(2L, 2L)))
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(m0_init)))
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(P0_init)))

  n_trade <- ncol(Y_trade)

  # ── 1. Build state-space arrays from fixed theta_hat ──────────────────────
  # Uses the exact same make_ss_arrays() as the estimation code.
  # Parameters are FIXED at theta_hat, no re-estimation here.
  ss <- make_ss_arrays(theta_hat, Tau_trade, Delta_t)

  if (any(!is.finite(ss$ct))) {
    stop("Block ", block_id, ": make_ss_arrays() produced non-finite ct. ",
         "Check theta_hat validity.")
  }

  # ── 2. Apply missing data mask ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Identical procedure to estimation code, missing contracts are neutralised
  # in the measurement equation and their variance is inflated to near-infinity.
  masked <- apply_missing_mask_fkf(Y_trade, ss)

  # ── 3. Run Kalman filter with the correctly timed predictive prior ─────────
  # FKF updates the first supplied observation before applying its next state
  # transition. Therefore a0/P0 must already describe the first trading-week
  # state. The caller supplies at[, n_train + 1] / Pt[,, n_train + 1] from a
  # clean training-sample refilter under the current annual theta.
  kf <- tryCatch(
    fkf(
      a0  = m0_init,   P0  = P0_init,    # prior mean and covariance
      dt  = masked$dt, ct  = masked$ct,  # state drift + measurement intercept
      Tt  = masked$Tt, Zt  = masked$Zt,  # transition + measurement matrices
      HHt = masked$HHt, GGt = masked$GGt,# process noise + measurement noise
      yt  = masked$yt                    # observations (NAs replaced + masked)
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      stop("Block ", block_id, ": fkf() failed during forward filter. ",
           "Error: ", conditionMessage(e))
    }
  )

  if (any(kf$status != 0L)) {
    warning("Block ", block_id,
            ": FKF LAPACK failure status: ", paste(kf$status, collapse = ", "),
            ". Results may be unreliable for this trading year.")
  }

  # ── 4. Extract filtered state paths ───────────────────────────────────────
  # fkf$att is the 2 x n_trade matrix of POSTERIOR filtered means.
  # att[1, t] = E[chi_t | y_1,...,y_t]; short-term factor at week t
  # att[2, t] = E[xi_t  | y_1,...,y_t]; long-term factor at week t
  # This is what we use for the signal; posterior, not prior.
  chi_vec <- as.numeric(kf$att[1L, ])   # length n_trade
  xi_vec  <- as.numeric(kf$att[2L, ])   # length n_trade

  stopifnot(length(chi_vec) == n_trade)
  stopifnot(length(xi_vec)  == n_trade)

  # ── 5. Extract final state and covariance for diagnostics ─────────────────
  # att[, n_trade]   = filtered state at the last week of this trading year
  # Ptt[,, n_trade]  = filtered covariance at the last week of this trading year
  att_last <- as.numeric(kf$att[, n_trade])     # length 2
  Ptt_last <- kf$Ptt[, , n_trade]               # 2 x 2 matrix

  stopifnot(length(att_last) == 2L)
  stopifnot(all(dim(Ptt_last) == c(2L, 2L)))
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(att_last)))

  list(
    chi_vec  = chi_vec,
    xi_vec   = xi_vec,
    att_last = att_last,
    Ptt_last = Ptt_last,
    kf       = kf
  )
}

```

## Step 5: Signal Construction and Position Generation

This section defines generate_signals(), which takes the filtered chi
path from Step 4 and converts its sign directly into the next week's
position. There are no entry, exit or time-stop thresholds. A change in
the sign of chi creates a direct position reversal.

```{r step5, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

#############################################################################
# STEP 5.0 — generate_signals(): signal and position logic for one trading year
#
# Arguments:
#   chi_vec    : numeric vector length n_trade, filtered chi from run_forward_kf()
#                = att[1, ] for the trading window
#   theta_hat  : parameter list from estimate_ss(), needed for sigma_chi_inf
#   block_id   : integer label used in messages only
#
# Returns a list:
#   $z_vec          : numeric vector length n_trade; z-score of chi each week
#   $pos_CL1        : integer vector length n_trade; position in CL1 each week
#                     +1 = long CL1, -1 = short CL1, 0 = flat
#   $pos_CL17       : integer vector length n_trade; position in CL17 each week
#                     always exactly opposite sign to pos_CL1 (ξ-neutral hedge)
#                     +1 = long CL17, -1 = short CL17, 0 = flat
#   $trade_log      : data frame with one row per trade (entry week, direction,
#                     exit week, n_weeks_held)
#
# Position convention (equal and opposite contracts):
#   chi < 0 -> LONG spread:  pos_CL1 = +1, pos_CL17 = -1
#   chi > 0 -> SHORT spread: pos_CL1 = -1, pos_CL17 = +1
#   chi = 0 -> FLAT. A missing chi observation carries the prior position.
#
# Timing convention (CRITICAL — no look-ahead):
#   Signal at end of week t uses chi_vec[t] = att[1,t] = E[chi_t | y_1..y_t]
#   Position is entered at the open of week t+1 (i.e. held during week t+1)
#   P&L for week t+1 = pos[t] * (price[t+1] - price[t]) * CONTRACT_SIZE
#   This is enforced in Step 6 (P&L). Here we store end-of-week-t positions.
#
# Trading rules:
#   - Direction is determined only by the sign of filtered chi.
#   - A sign change closes the old trade and opens the opposite trade.
#   - There is no filter
#############################################################################

generate_signals <- function(chi_vec, theta_hat, block_id,
                             is_ltd_CL1 = NULL,
                             initial_pos = 0L) {
  # Entries are not suppressed on LTD weeks because the
  # explicit execution layer handles safe pre-roll selection.
  n <- length(chi_vec)
  stopifnot(n >= 1L)
  stopifnot(is.finite(theta_hat$kappa))
  stopifnot(theta_hat$kappa > 0)
  stopifnot(is.finite(theta_hat$sigma_chi))
  stopifnot(theta_hat$sigma_chi > 0)
  stopifnot(length(initial_pos) == 1L, initial_pos %in% c(-1L, 0L, 1L))
  if (!is.null(is_ltd_CL1)) stopifnot(length(is_ltd_CL1) == n)

  # ── 1. Compute z-score ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Normalise by the empirical SD of filtered chi over the training window,
  # stored as theta_hat$sigma_chi_emp inside estimate_ss().
  # Fallback to theoretical steady-state SD if sigma_chi_emp is unavailable.
  sigma_chi_normaliser <- if (!is.null(theta_hat$sigma_chi_emp) &&
                               is.finite(theta_hat$sigma_chi_emp) &&
                               theta_hat$sigma_chi_emp > 0) {
    theta_hat$sigma_chi_emp
  } else {
    warning("Block ", block_id,
            ": sigma_chi_emp unavailable — falling back to theoretical sigma_chi_inf")
    theta_hat$sigma_chi / sqrt(2 * theta_hat$kappa)
  }
  z_vec <- chi_vec / sigma_chi_normaliser

  # ── 2. Initialise position vectors ────────────────────────────────────────
  pos_CL1  <- integer(n)    # +1, -1, or 0
  pos_CL17 <- integer(n)    # always = -pos_CL1 (ξ-neutral)

  # ── 3. Walk through time applying the raw-sign rule ───────────────────────
  # current_pos tracks the active position:
  #   0  = flat
  #  +1  = long spread  (long CL1, short CL17)
  #  -1  = short spread (short CL1, long CL17)
  # At an annual boundary this is the position actually held during the final
  # December week. The refiltered December state is prepended by the caller,
  # so the first signal decision determines the first January holding.
  current_pos <- as.integer(initial_pos)

  # Trade log storage
  trade_entries <- list()
  open_trade_week <- if (current_pos == 0L) NA_integer_ else 0L

  for (t in seq_len(n)) {

    chi_t <- chi_vec[t]
    new_pos <- if (!is.finite(chi_t)) {
      current_pos
    } else if (chi_t < 0) {
      1L
    } else if (chi_t > 0) {
      -1L
    } else {
      0L
    }

    if (new_pos != current_pos) {
      if (current_pos != 0L) {
        trade_entries[[length(trade_entries) + 1L]] <- list(
          entry_week = open_trade_week,
          direction  = if (current_pos == 1L) "long" else "short",
          exit_week  = t,
          n_weeks    = t - open_trade_week
        )
      }
      open_trade_week <- if (new_pos == 0L) NA_integer_ else t
    }

    # Store position for this week
    pos_CL1[t]  <-  new_pos
    pos_CL17[t] <- -new_pos
    current_pos <- new_pos
  }

  # ── 4. Handle open trade at end of trading year ───────────────────────────
  # If a position is still open at the last week of the trading year,
  # we do NOT force-close it. The position carries forward into the next year.
  # We record it in the trade log as open (exit_week = NA).
  if (current_pos != 0L) {
    trade_entries[[length(trade_entries) + 1L]] <- list(
      entry_week = open_trade_week,
      direction  = if (current_pos == 1L) "long" else "short",
      exit_week  = NA_integer_,
      n_weeks    = NA_integer_
    )
  }

  # ── 5. Build trade log data frame ─────────────────────────────────────────
  if (length(trade_entries) > 0L) {
    trade_log <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      purrr::map(trade_entries, ~ dplyr::as_tibble(.x))
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(block_id = block_id)
  } else {
    trade_log <- dplyr::tibble(
      entry_week = integer(0),
      direction  = character(0),
      exit_week  = integer(0),
      n_weeks    = integer(0),
      block_id   = integer(0)
    )
  }

  list(
    z_vec    = z_vec,
    pos_CL1  = pos_CL1,
    pos_CL17 = pos_CL17,
    trade_log = trade_log,
    state_end = list(current_pos = current_pos)
  )
}


```

## Step 6: P&L Calculation

This section defines compute_pnl(), which takes the position vectors
from Step 5 and the raw dollar prices, T-bill rate, roll flags, and
running capital to produce a week-by-week P&L data frame for one trading
year. Strategy P&L, T-bill income on idle cash, and total compounding
capital are all computed here.

```{r step6, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

#############################################################################
# STEP 6.0 — compute_pnl(): weekly P&L for one trading year
#
# Arguments:
#   pos_CL1      : integer vector length n_trade, CL1 position (+1/-1/0)
#                  from generate_signals(). Position at END of week t is
#                  applied to the price CHANGE during week t+1.
#   pos_CL17     : integer vector length n_trade; CL17 position (always -pos_CL1)
#   price_CL1_t  : numeric vector length n_trade; raw dollar price of CL1
#   price_CL17_t : numeric vector length n_trade; raw dollar price of CL17
#   dtb3_t       : numeric vector length n_trade; DTB3 rate (annualised %)
#   roll_CL1_t   : integer vector length n_trade; 1 if CL1 rolled this week
#   roll_CL17_t  : integer vector length n_trade; 1 if CL17 rolled this week
#   capital_start: numeric scalar; capital at start of this trading year ($)
#   trade_dates  : Date vector length n_trade;  obs_dates for this trading year
#   block_id     : integer label used in messages only
#
# Returns a tibble with one row per week:
#   date             : observation date (end of week t)
#   pos_CL1          : position in CL1 held DURING this week (set at end of t-1)
#   pos_CL17         : position in CL17 held DURING this week
#   price_CL1        : dollar price of CL1 at end of week t
#   price_CL17       : dollar price of CL17 at end of week t
#   strategy_pnl_gross: futures P&L before costs earned DURING week t ($)
#   transaction_cost : implementation costs charged DURING week t ($)
#   strategy_pnl     : net futures P&L earned DURING week t ($)
#   margin_posted    : margin held aside DURING week t ($)
#   idle_cash        : cash earning T-bill rate DURING week t ($)
#   tbill_rate_weekly: weekly T-bill return applied DURING week t
#   tbill_pnl        : T-bill income earned DURING week t ($)
#   total_pnl        : strategy_pnl + tbill_pnl for week t ($)
#   capital          : cumulative capital at END of week t ($)
#   roll_CL1         : roll flag for CL1 this week (0/1)
#   roll_CL17        : roll flag for CL17 this week (0/1)
#
# Timing convention (consistent with Step 5):
#   pos_CL1[t-1] is the position decided at end of week t-1.
#   strategy_pnl_gross[t] = pos_CL1[t-1] * (price_CL1[t] - price_CL1[t-1]) *
#                           CONTRACT_SIZE
#   strategy_pnl[t] = strategy_pnl_gross[t] - transaction_cost[t]
#   For t=1: pos_start_CL1 is held over the first weekly return.
#   pos_prev_CL1 is the position immediately before the boundary rebalance and
#   is used to identify, size and charge any boundary entry, exit or flip.
#
# T-bill:
#   DTB3 is annualised percent. Weekly return = (1 + DTB3/100)^(7/365.25) - 1.
#   All capital earns T-bill rate each week (fully collateralised convention).
#############################################################################

compute_pnl <- function(pos_CL1, pos_CL17, price_CL1_t, price_CL17_t,
                        und_CL1_t, und_CL17_t, ltd_CL1_t, ltd_CL17_t,
                        px_all_t, und_all_t, ltd_all_t,
                        dtb3_t, roll_CL1_t, roll_CL17_t,
                        capital_start, trade_dates, block_id,
                        pos_start_CL1    = 0L,
                        pos_prev_CL1     = pos_start_CL1,
                        px_prev_row      = NULL,
                        und_prev_row     = NULL,
                        ltd_prev_row     = NULL,
                        held_und_prev_CL1  = NA_character_,
                        held_und_prev_CL17 = NA_character_,
                        n_contracts      = 1L,
                        entry_level_sd_t = NULL) {

  n <- length(pos_CL1)
  stopifnot(n >= 1L)
  stopifnot(length(pos_CL17)     == n)
  stopifnot(length(price_CL1_t)  == n)
  stopifnot(length(price_CL17_t) == n)
  stopifnot(length(und_CL1_t)    == n)
  stopifnot(length(und_CL17_t)   == n)
  stopifnot(length(ltd_CL1_t)    == n)
  stopifnot(length(ltd_CL17_t)   == n)
  stopifnot(nrow(px_all_t)       == n)
  stopifnot(nrow(und_all_t)      == n)
  stopifnot(nrow(ltd_all_t)      == n)
  stopifnot(length(dtb3_t)       == n)
  stopifnot(length(roll_CL1_t)   == n)
  stopifnot(length(roll_CL17_t)  == n)
  stopifnot(length(trade_dates)  == n)
  stopifnot(is.finite(capital_start) && capital_start > 0)

  # Output vectors, pre-allocated for speed
  strategy_pnl_gross    <- numeric(n)
  transaction_cost      <- numeric(n)
  strategy_pnl          <- numeric(n)
  tbill_pnl             <- numeric(n)
  total_pnl             <- numeric(n)
  capital               <- numeric(n)
  capital_start_week_vec<- numeric(n)
  idle_cash_vec         <- numeric(n)
  margin_posted_vec     <- numeric(n)
  margin_face_value_vec <- numeric(n)
  maintenance_margin_vec<- numeric(n)
  stress_margin_vec     <- numeric(n)
  stress_margin_limit_vec <- numeric(n)
  stress_util_start_vec <- numeric(n)
  stress_util_end_vec   <- numeric(n)
  margin_capacity_vec   <- integer(n)
  desired_contracts_vec <- integer(n)
  tbill_rate_weekly     <- numeric(n)
  n_contracts_vec       <- integer(n)
  contracts_traded_CL1  <- numeric(n)
  contracts_traded_CL17 <- numeric(n)
  maintenance_margin_call <- logical(n)
  stress_limit_breach   <- logical(n)
  margin_cap_binding    <- logical(n)
  margin_entry_cap      <- logical(n)
  margin_forced_reduction <- logical(n)
  margin_action         <- rep("none", n)
  held_pos_CL1          <- integer(n)
  held_pos_CL17         <- integer(n)
  held_und_CL1          <- rep(NA_character_, n)
  held_und_CL17         <- rep(NA_character_, n)
  generic_und_CL1       <- und_CL1_t
  generic_und_CL17      <- und_CL17_t
  held_price_prev_CL1   <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  held_price_prev_CL17  <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  held_price_curr_CL1   <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  held_price_curr_CL17  <- rep(NA_real_, n)
  exec_roll_CL1         <- logical(n)
  exec_roll_CL17        <- logical(n)
  roll_reason_CL1       <- rep("none", n)
  roll_reason_CL17      <- rep("none", n)
  trade_change_type     <- rep("none", n)
  cost_event_type       <- rep("none", n)

  # Running capital; starts at capital_start, compounds each week
  capital_running <- capital_start

  # n_contracts_current tracks the size of the active trade.
  # It is recalculated only when a new trade is entered using the
  # entry-date EMA spread-level dispersion. Size is then held constant for the
  # duration of the trade, including across year boundaries.
  n_contracts_current <- n_contracts

  stopifnot(length(entry_level_sd_t) == n)
  stopifnot(MAINTENANCE_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD > 0)
  stopifnot(INITIAL_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD >= MAINTENANCE_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD)
  stopifnot(STRESS_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD ==
              INITIAL_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD * MARGIN_STRESS_MULTIPLIER)
  stopifnot(MAX_STRESS_MARGIN_UTILIZATION > 0,
            MAX_STRESS_MARGIN_UTILIZATION < 1)
  stopifnot(length(pos_prev_CL1) == 1L, pos_prev_CL1 %in% c(-1L, 0L, 1L))
  prior_has_position <- pos_prev_CL1 != 0L && n_contracts > 0L
  held_ticker_prev_CL1  <- if (prior_has_position) held_und_prev_CL1  else NA_character_
  held_ticker_prev_CL17 <- if (prior_has_position) held_und_prev_CL17 else NA_character_

  for (t in seq_len(n)) {

    # ── Position held DURING week t ─────────────────────────────────────────
    # This is the position that was set at end of week t-1.
    # For t=1: use the position selected by the final December signal
    # For t>1: use pos_CL1[t-1]
    pos_t_CL1  <- if (t == 1L) pos_start_CL1 else pos_CL1[t - 1L]
    pos_t_CL17 <- -pos_t_CL1    # always exactly opposite (xi-neutral)

    # ── Entry-time spread-range sizing ───────────────────────────────────────
    # A fresh trade is sized only when going from flat to positioned or when
    # flipping direction. There is no year-start resizing of carried trades.
    prev_pos_held_week <- if (t == 1L) {
      if (prior_has_position) pos_prev_CL1 else 0L
    } else {
      held_pos_CL1[t - 1L]
    }
    prev_contracts_held <- if (t == 1L) {
      if (prior_has_position) n_contracts else 0L
    } else {
      n_contracts_vec[t - 1L]
    }

    is_new_trade <- (pos_t_CL1 != 0L &&
                     (prev_contracts_held == 0L || prev_pos_held_week != pos_t_CL1))
    if (is_new_trade) {
      entry_level_sd <- entry_level_sd_t[t]
      use_range_sizing <- is.finite(entry_level_sd) && entry_level_sd > 0
      if (use_range_sizing) {
        raw_n <- round((RANGE_BUDGET_PCT * capital_running) /
                       (entry_level_sd * CONTRACT_SIZE))
        n_contracts_current <- max(N_CONTRACTS_MIN,
                                   min(N_CONTRACTS_MAX, as.integer(raw_n)))
      } else {
        warning("Block ", block_id, " week ", t,
                ": entry spread-level SD unavailable — falling back to 25 contracts")
        n_contracts_current <- 25L
      }
    }

    # Margin is a feasibility constraint, not an alpha or risk-sizing input.
    # The 2x stressed requirement may reduce, but never increase, risk-based
    # sizing. The same rule is checked weekly for carried positions.
    capital_start_week_t <- capital_running
    margin_capacity_t <- max(
      0L,
      as.integer(floor(
        (MAX_STRESS_MARGIN_UTILIZATION * capital_start_week_t) /
          STRESS_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD
      ))
    )
    desired_contracts_t <- if (pos_t_CL1 != 0L) n_contracts_current else 0L
    margin_cap_binding_t <- desired_contracts_t > margin_capacity_t
    margin_entry_cap_t <- is_new_trade && margin_cap_binding_t
    margin_forced_reduction_t <- !is_new_trade &&
      prev_contracts_held > 0L &&
      desired_contracts_t > margin_capacity_t
    margin_action_t <- "none"

    if (margin_cap_binding_t) {
      feasible_contracts_t <- if (margin_capacity_t >= N_CONTRACTS_MIN) {
        margin_capacity_t
      } else {
        0L
      }
      n_contracts_current <- feasible_contracts_t
      margin_action_t <- dplyr::case_when(
        is_new_trade && feasible_contracts_t == 0L ~ "entry_blocked",
        is_new_trade ~ "entry_capped",
        feasible_contracts_t == 0L ~ "forced_flat",
        TRUE ~ "forced_reduction"
      )
      if (feasible_contracts_t == 0L) {
        pos_t_CL1 <- 0L
        pos_t_CL17 <- 0L
      }
    }

    current_contracts_held <- if (pos_t_CL1 != 0L) n_contracts_current else 0L

    prev_signed_qty_CL1  <- prev_pos_held_week * prev_contracts_held
    prev_signed_qty_CL17 <- -prev_pos_held_week * prev_contracts_held
    curr_signed_qty_CL1  <- pos_t_CL1 * current_contracts_held
    curr_signed_qty_CL17 <- pos_t_CL17 * current_contracts_held

    row_prev_px  <- if (t == 1L) px_prev_row  else px_all_t[t - 1L, ]
    row_prev_und <- if (t == 1L) und_prev_row else und_all_t[t - 1L, ]
    row_prev_ltd <- if (t == 1L) ltd_prev_row else ltd_all_t[t - 1L, ]
    row_curr_px  <- px_all_t[t, ]
    row_curr_und <- und_all_t[t, ]

    held_ltd_prev_CL1  <- if (!is.na(held_ticker_prev_CL1))
      lookup_ticker_ltd(row_prev_ltd, row_prev_und, held_ticker_prev_CL1) else as.Date(NA)
    held_ltd_prev_CL17 <- if (!is.na(held_ticker_prev_CL17))
      lookup_ticker_ltd(row_prev_ltd, row_prev_und, held_ticker_prev_CL17) else as.Date(NA)

    target_ticker_CL1 <- if (curr_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L) {
      choose_execution_ticker(
        held_ticker       = held_ticker_prev_CL1,
        generic_ticker_next = und_CL1_t[t],
        prev_und_row      = row_prev_und,
        prev_ltd_row      = row_prev_ltd,
        next_obs_date     = trade_dates[t]
      )
    } else NA_character_

    target_ticker_CL17 <- if (curr_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L) {
      choose_execution_ticker(
        held_ticker       = held_ticker_prev_CL17,
        generic_ticker_next = und_CL17_t[t],
        prev_und_row      = row_prev_und,
        prev_ltd_row      = row_prev_ltd,
        next_obs_date     = trade_dates[t]
      )
    } else NA_character_

    generic_switch_CL1 <- prev_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L &&
      !is.na(held_ticker_prev_CL1) &&
      !is.na(und_CL1_t[t]) &&
      held_ticker_prev_CL1 != und_CL1_t[t]
    generic_switch_CL17 <- prev_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L &&
      !is.na(held_ticker_prev_CL17) &&
      !is.na(und_CL17_t[t]) &&
      held_ticker_prev_CL17 != und_CL17_t[t]

    ltd_unsafe_CL1 <- prev_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L &&
      !is.na(held_ltd_prev_CL1) &&
      held_ltd_prev_CL1 <= trade_dates[t]
    ltd_unsafe_CL17 <- prev_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L &&
      !is.na(held_ltd_prev_CL17) &&
      held_ltd_prev_CL17 <= trade_dates[t]

    exec_roll_CL1_t <- prev_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L &&
      curr_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L &&
      !is.na(held_ticker_prev_CL1) &&
      !is.na(target_ticker_CL1) &&
      held_ticker_prev_CL1 != target_ticker_CL1
    exec_roll_CL17_t <- prev_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L &&
      curr_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L &&
      !is.na(held_ticker_prev_CL17) &&
      !is.na(target_ticker_CL17) &&
      held_ticker_prev_CL17 != target_ticker_CL17

    roll_reason_CL1_t <- if (exec_roll_CL1_t) {
      if (generic_switch_CL1 && ltd_unsafe_CL1) "generic+ltd" else
        if (generic_switch_CL1) "generic" else "ltd"
    } else "none"
    roll_reason_CL17_t <- if (exec_roll_CL17_t) {
      if (generic_switch_CL17 && ltd_unsafe_CL17) "generic+ltd" else
        if (generic_switch_CL17) "generic" else "ltd"
    } else "none"

    prev_price_exec_CL1 <- if (prev_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L && !is.na(held_ticker_prev_CL1))
      lookup_ticker_price(row_prev_px, row_prev_und, held_ticker_prev_CL1) else NA_real_
    prev_price_exec_CL17 <- if (prev_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L && !is.na(held_ticker_prev_CL17))
      lookup_ticker_price(row_prev_px, row_prev_und, held_ticker_prev_CL17) else NA_real_
    curr_price_prev_CL1 <- if (curr_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L && !is.na(target_ticker_CL1))
      lookup_ticker_price(row_prev_px, row_prev_und, target_ticker_CL1) else NA_real_
    curr_price_prev_CL17 <- if (curr_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L && !is.na(target_ticker_CL17))
      lookup_ticker_price(row_prev_px, row_prev_und, target_ticker_CL17) else NA_real_
    curr_price_now_CL1 <- if (curr_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L && !is.na(target_ticker_CL1))
      lookup_ticker_price(row_curr_px, row_curr_und, target_ticker_CL1) else NA_real_
    curr_price_now_CL17 <- if (curr_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L && !is.na(target_ticker_CL17))
      lookup_ticker_price(row_curr_px, row_curr_und, target_ticker_CL17) else NA_real_

    if (curr_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L &&
        (is.na(curr_price_prev_CL1) || is.na(curr_price_now_CL1))) {
      stop("Block ", block_id, " week ", t,
           ": missing explicit CL1 execution prices for ticker ", target_ticker_CL1)
    }
    if (curr_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L &&
        (is.na(curr_price_prev_CL17) || is.na(curr_price_now_CL17))) {
      stop("Block ", block_id, " week ", t,
           ": missing explicit CL17 execution prices for ticker ", target_ticker_CL17)
    }

    trade_qty_CL1 <- if (prev_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L &&
                         curr_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L &&
                         !is.na(held_ticker_prev_CL1) &&
                         !is.na(target_ticker_CL1) &&
                         held_ticker_prev_CL1 == target_ticker_CL1) {
      abs(curr_signed_qty_CL1 - prev_signed_qty_CL1)
    } else {
      abs(prev_signed_qty_CL1) + abs(curr_signed_qty_CL1)
    }

    trade_qty_CL17 <- if (prev_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L &&
                          curr_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L &&
                          !is.na(held_ticker_prev_CL17) &&
                          !is.na(target_ticker_CL17) &&
                          held_ticker_prev_CL17 == target_ticker_CL17) {
      abs(curr_signed_qty_CL17 - prev_signed_qty_CL17)
    } else {
      abs(prev_signed_qty_CL17) + abs(curr_signed_qty_CL17)
    }

    notional_CL1 <- if (prev_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L &&
                        curr_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L &&
                        !is.na(held_ticker_prev_CL1) &&
                        !is.na(target_ticker_CL1) &&
                        held_ticker_prev_CL1 == target_ticker_CL1) {
      abs(curr_signed_qty_CL1 - prev_signed_qty_CL1) * curr_price_prev_CL1
    } else {
      abs(prev_signed_qty_CL1) * dplyr::coalesce(prev_price_exec_CL1, 0) +
        abs(curr_signed_qty_CL1) * dplyr::coalesce(curr_price_prev_CL1, 0)
    }

    notional_CL17 <- if (prev_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L &&
                         curr_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L &&
                         !is.na(held_ticker_prev_CL17) &&
                         !is.na(target_ticker_CL17) &&
                         held_ticker_prev_CL17 == target_ticker_CL17) {
      abs(curr_signed_qty_CL17 - prev_signed_qty_CL17) * curr_price_prev_CL17
    } else {
      abs(prev_signed_qty_CL17) * dplyr::coalesce(prev_price_exec_CL17, 0) +
        abs(curr_signed_qty_CL17) * dplyr::coalesce(curr_price_prev_CL17, 0)
    }

    transaction_cost_t <- REFERENCE_TX_COST_BPS_ONE_WAY * CONTRACT_SIZE *
      (notional_CL1 + notional_CL17)

    # ── Strategy P&L for week t ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    dprice_exec_CL1  <- if (curr_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L)
      curr_price_now_CL1 - curr_price_prev_CL1 else 0
    dprice_exec_CL17 <- if (curr_signed_qty_CL17 != 0L)
      curr_price_now_CL17 - curr_price_prev_CL17 else 0

    strat_pnl_gross_t <- (curr_signed_qty_CL1  * dprice_exec_CL1 +
                          curr_signed_qty_CL17 * dprice_exec_CL17) *
      CONTRACT_SIZE
    strat_pnl_t <- strat_pnl_gross_t - transaction_cost_t

    # ── Margin and idle cash at start of week t ──────────────────────────────
    # Initial margin is posted when a position is open, zero when flat.
    # Only the FREE CASH (capital minus margin posted) earns T-bill return.
    # Maintenance and stress amounts are monitored separately. The 2x amount
    # is a conservative house stress constraint; it is not collateral posted.
    is_open                     <- (curr_signed_qty_CL1 != 0L)
    margin_t                    <- INITIAL_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD * current_contracts_held
    maintenance_margin_t        <- MAINTENANCE_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD * current_contracts_held
    stress_margin_t             <- STRESS_MARGIN_PER_SPREAD * current_contracts_held
    stress_margin_limit_t       <- MAX_STRESS_MARGIN_UTILIZATION * capital_start_week_t
    stress_utilization_start_t  <- if (capital_start_week_t > 0) {
      stress_margin_t / capital_start_week_t
    } else {
      Inf
    }
    margin_face_value_t <- margin_t / (1 - TBILL_HAIRCUT)
    idle_cash_t         <- capital_start_week_t - margin_t

    # This should be guaranteed by the stricter 2x/80% capacity constraint.
    if (idle_cash_t < -1e-8 ||
        stress_margin_t > stress_margin_limit_t + 1e-8) {
      stop("Block ", block_id, " week ", t,
           ": internal margin-cap invariant failed")
    }
    idle_cash_t <- max(idle_cash_t, 0)

    # Solvency check: capital must cover the face value of T-Bills pledged
    if (capital_start_week_t < margin_face_value_t) {
      stop("Block ", block_id, " week ", t,
```
