```{r save-results, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
      main_results_table = rv_main_results_table,
      oos_one_spread_comparison = rv_oos_one_spread_comparison,
      final_oos = rv_final_oos,
      final_oos_drawdown = rv_final_oos_drawdown_data
    ),
    robustness = list(
      costs = cost_sensitivity,
      unconditional_short = short_benchmark_periods,
      all_timing_periods = appendix_timing_periods,
      all_sizing_periods = appendix_sizing_periods
    )
  ),
  file.path(PATH_OUTPUT, "Final_RV_Strategy_Results.rds")
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(sessionInfo()),
  file.path(PATH_OUTPUT, "sessionInfo.txt")
)

```

## Conclusion

```{r conclusion, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

calibration_result <- selected_period_summary %>%
  filter(period == "Calibration 2000-2016")
oos_result <- selected_period_summary %>%
  filter(period == "Out-of-sample 2017-2025")
full_result <- selected_period_summary %>%
  filter(period == "Full 2000-2025")
oos_activity <- activity_summary %>%
  filter(period == "Out-of-sample 2017-2025")

cat(
  "The final strategy enters at **|z| = ", frozen_selection$entry,
  "**, exits at **|z| = ", frozen_selection$exit,
  "**, and uses a **", frozen_selection$time_stop,
  "-week maximum holding period**. Contracts are fixed at entry using the ",
  "lagged 26-week-half-life spread-level dispersion.\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "It earns **", dollar(calibration_result$net_futures_pnl, accuracy = 1),
  "** in calibration and **", dollar(oos_result$net_futures_pnl, accuracy = 1),
  "** in the single out-of-sample period, after the base transaction costs. ",
  "The full-sample net futures P&L is **",
  dollar(full_result$net_futures_pnl, accuracy = 1), "**.\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "The OOS evidence is positive but still limited: the strategy enters **",
  oos_result$trades_entered, " trades**, is active for **",
  percent(oos_activity$active_share_pct / 100, accuracy = 0.1),
  "** of OOS weeks, and its maximum futures-P&L drawdown is **",
  percent(abs(oos_result$max_futures_drawdown_pct) / 100, accuracy = 0.1),
  "**. The appropriate thesis conclusion is therefore that the result supports ",
  "the economic usefulness of SS2000 timing in this sample, not that profitability ",
  "has been established universally.\n",
  sep = ""
)

```

## Thesis main-text figures

The following plotting-only section creates the final main-text figures. It does
not recalibrate the strategy and does not overwrite the earlier diagnostic
figures. It can be rerun on its own after the completed strategy results have
been loaded or saved.

```{r thesis-main-text-figures-final-rv, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}

if (!exists("PATH_OUTPUT", inherits = TRUE)) {
  stop("PATH_OUTPUT is not available. Run the setup section before this plotting section.")
}

rv_thesis_results_path <- file.path(PATH_OUTPUT, "Final_RV_Strategy_Results.rds")
if (!exists("rv_oos_one_spread_comparison", inherits = TRUE) ||
    !exists("selected_weekly", inherits = TRUE)) {
  if (!file.exists(rv_thesis_results_path)) {
    stop(
      "The plotting section needs either the completed strategy objects or ",
      "Final_RV_Strategy_Results.rds."
    )
  }
  rv_thesis_saved_results <- readRDS(rv_thesis_results_path)
  if (!exists("rv_oos_one_spread_comparison", inherits = TRUE)) {
    rv_oos_one_spread_comparison <-
      rv_thesis_saved_results$thesis_reporting$oos_one_spread_comparison
  }
  if (!exists("selected_weekly", inherits = TRUE)) {
    selected_weekly <- rv_thesis_saved_results$selected_strategy$weekly
  }
}

# The same palette and theme are used in the directional-strategy figures.
rv_thesis_colour_unoptimised <- "#7A7A7A"
rv_thesis_colour_optimised <- "#1F6A5A"
rv_thesis_colour_benchmark <- "#C47A3A"
rv_thesis_colour_net_futures <- "#1F6A5A"
rv_thesis_colour_total_account <- "#2F5597"
rv_thesis_colour_long <- "#1F6A5A"
rv_thesis_colour_short <- "#B5523B"

rv_thesis_figure_theme <- function(base_size = 11) {
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size, base_family = "sans") +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        face = "bold", colour = "#222222", margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 3)
      ),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(
        colour = "#4A4A4A", margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 9)
      ),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#222222"),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#3A3A3A"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(colour = "#333333"),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(10, 14, 10, 10)
    )
}

# 28) Relative-value strategy: comparable one-spread OOS implementations.
rv_thesis_one_spread_data <- rv_oos_one_spread_comparison |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    specification = dplyr::recode(
      specification,
      `Raw signal` = "Unoptimised one-spread signal",
      `Optimised timing rule` = "Optimised one-spread rule",
      `Always-short benchmark` = "Always-short benchmark"
    ),
    specification = factor(
      specification,
      levels = c(
        "Unoptimised one-spread signal",
        "Optimised one-spread rule",
        "Always-short benchmark"
      )
    )
  )

rv_thesis_one_spread_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  rv_thesis_one_spread_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    date,
    cumulative_net_futures_pnl / 1000,
    colour = specification
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#4A4A4A", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Unoptimised one-spread signal" = rv_thesis_colour_unoptimised,
    "Optimised one-spread rule" = rv_thesis_colour_optimised,
    "Always-short benchmark" = rv_thesis_colour_benchmark
  )) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Relative-value calendar-spread strategy",
    subtitle = "Out-of-sample comparison of one-spread implementations, 2017–2025",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cumulative net futures P&L (USD thousands)"
  ) +
  rv_thesis_figure_theme()

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(PATH_OUTPUT, "28_thesis_rv_one_spread_comparison.png"),
  rv_thesis_one_spread_plot,
  width = 9,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

# 29) Relative-value strategy: final cumulative performance and signed exposure.
rv_thesis_final_oos <- selected_weekly |>
  dplyr::filter(date >= OOS_START) |>
  dplyr::arrange(date) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cumulative_net_futures_pnl = cumsum(net_pnl),
    cumulative_total_account_pnl = cumsum(net_pnl + tbill_pnl),
    signed_spreads = position * contracts,
    direction_label = dplyr::case_when(
      signed_spreads > 0 ~ "Long spread",
      signed_spreads < 0 ~ "Short spread",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

rv_thesis_final_lines <- rv_thesis_final_oos |>
  dplyr::select(
    date,
    `Net futures P&L` = cumulative_net_futures_pnl,
    `Total account P&L including Treasury income` = cumulative_total_account_pnl
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    -date,
    names_to = "series",
    values_to = "cumulative_pnl"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    series = factor(
      series,
      levels = c(
        "Net futures P&L",
        "Total account P&L including Treasury income"
      )
    )
  )

rv_thesis_performance_panel <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  rv_thesis_final_lines,
  ggplot2::aes(date, cumulative_pnl / 1000, colour = series)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#4A4A4A", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "Net futures P&L" = rv_thesis_colour_net_futures,
    "Total account P&L including Treasury income" = rv_thesis_colour_total_account
  )) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Cumulative performance",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cumulative P&L (USD thousands)"
  ) +
  rv_thesis_figure_theme()

rv_thesis_exposure_panel <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  rv_thesis_final_oos |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(direction_label)),
  ggplot2::aes(date, signed_spreads, fill = direction_label)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 6.2) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#4A4A4A", linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Long spread" = rv_thesis_colour_long,
    "Short spread" = rv_thesis_colour_short
  )) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Signed position",
    x = NULL,
    y = "CL1–CL17 spreads",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  rv_thesis_figure_theme()

rv_thesis_final_figure <- patchwork::wrap_plots(
  rv_thesis_performance_panel,
  rv_thesis_exposure_panel,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = c(1.35, 1),
  guides = "collect"
) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "Final relative-value calendar-spread strategy",
    subtitle = "Out-of-sample performance and exposure, 2017–2025",
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, colour = "#222222"),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, colour = "#4A4A4A")
    )
  ) &
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggplot2::ggsave(
  file.path(PATH_OUTPUT, "29_thesis_rv_final_performance_and_exposure.png"),
  rv_thesis_final_figure,
  width = 9,
  height = 8.2,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

rv_thesis_one_spread_plot
rv_thesis_final_figure
```
